name: Dwarf Warpriest (CR 10)
body:
DWARF WARPRIEST 10
CR 12

Dwarf warpriest 10 (forgepriest)/furious guardian 2
LG Medium humanoid (dwarf)
Init +0; Senses darkvision 60 ft., Perception +18/+20
Aura Good

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 10, flat-footed 20 (+10 armor); +4 dodge vs. monsters of the giant subtype
hp 119 (10d8+2d10+60)
Fort +12, Ref +4, Will +11; +2 racial bonus vs. poison, spells, and spell-like abilities
Defensive Abilities armor of earth (major blessing), guarded thoughts, sacred armor +2; Resist fire 5

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee hammer +16/+11 (1d10+8, x3)
Ranged hammer +12 (1d10+8, x3, +1d8 vs. creatures of the giant subtype)
Special Attacks priceless blade (minor blessing), rage 10 rounds/day, rage powers (intimidating glare*, lesser celestial totem), sacred weapon +2 (1d10)
Warpriest Spells Prepared (CL 10th; concentration +13)

4th Level—divine power
3rd Level—deadly juggernaut, keen edge, storm of blades, versatile weapon
2nd Level—heat metal, instant armor, spear of purity (DC 15), shatter, stalwart resolve
1st Level—burning disarm (DC 14), detect evil, divine favor, jury-rig, protection from evil, weapons against evil
0th-Level—detect magic, guidance, light, mending, resistance

STATISTICS

Str 19, Dex 10, Con 18, Int 14, Wis 16, Cha 12
Base Atk +9; CMB +13; CMD 23 (27 vs. bull rush or trip while standing on solid ground or vs. attempts to move her)
Traits Faith in the One, Zest for Battle
Feats Blessed Hammer, Cleave, Craft Magic Arms and Armor*, Great Cleave, Power Attack, Summon Guardian Spirit, Toughness, Weapon Focus* (warhammer), Weapon Specialization* (warhammer)
Skills Craft (jewelry) +23, Handle Animal +6, Intimidate +16, Knowledge (nobility) +7, Perception +18/+20, Sense Motive +18
Languages Celestial, Common, Dwarven, Elven
SQ blessings 11/day (Earth/Metal), chosen ally +1, creator’s bond, craftsman, fervor 8/day (3d6), forge mastery, industrious urbanite, stonecunning
Gear belt of physical might +2 (Str, Con), (10,000 gp), bastion boots (10,500 gp), hammer (25,312 gp), dwarven trail rations (2 gp), headband of vast intelligence +4 (16,000 gp), helm of fearsome mien (5,000 gp), icecap ale (40 gp), medal of the hero’s heart (3,400 gp), mithral full plate of speed (26,500 gp), potion of cure moderate wounds (300 gp), rod of metal and mineral detection (10,500 gp), titan’s tonic (200 gp), thunderstone (30 gp), warpriest’s kit (16 gp), 200 gp
